title: adj inbox filters by an exact ref

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A slice is ready to run only with no open design question (slicer rule u4; slicer s399 and s400, ork S116). Questions are linked to slices with `adj ask --ref S116`. `adj list` already filters by an exact ref (S20: `internal/cli/list.go`, `internal/query/filter.go`), and `adj context` does too. `adj inbox` has no filter, and `adj check` matches a substring, so `S11` also matches `S110` and `S116`. A spec check cannot ask "which open records reference S116" exactly from the inbox, with the options and recommendation shown. This slice adds `--ref` to `adj inbox` only. (The first draft said `list` lacked it; it does not.)

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/cli/inbox.go` (flag, usage, `--all` and `-i` handling), `internal/cli/inbox_interactive.go` if `-i` uses the filtered list, and `internal/cli/inbox_test.go`.
- `internal/commands/inbox.go` (`Inbox`, `InboxAll`): an input carrying `Refs`, with the blank-value check shared with `ListInput.Check` (`internal/commands/list.go:37`), not a copy.
- `internal/query/filter.go`: reuse `Filter.Refs`; no change expected.
- `docs/json.md` (no shape change; say the filter), `README.md`, `PROJECT.md` (command table), `AGENTS.md` (Commands: inbox), `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Red first, table-driven; `t.TempDir()` under `.cache/tmp` with an explicit `cli.Env.Root`.
- `adj inbox --ref S11` lists only open records whose refs contain `S11` exactly: records with `S110`, `S116` or `s11` do not match. Repeated `--ref` requires every ref. Order stays oldest first.
- `--json` prints `{"records": [...]}` filtered the same way; an empty match prints nothing (JSON: an empty array) and exits 0.
- A blank `--ref` exits 2 before the store is looked for, as in `adj list`. Refs are matched as typed, spaces included.
- Proposed under C32 (the implementer records them): with `--all`, the filter applies in each repo and a repo with no match keeps its header; with `-i`, the walk visits only matching questions and the summary counts only those. With no `--ref`, today's output is byte for byte unchanged.
- The usage text names `--ref`. Mutation-check: dropping the filter in the `--all` path fails a test.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: `--ref REF` on `inbox` (`adj list` and `adj context` already have it from S20): an exact, case-sensitive match against a record's refs, repeatable, with every given filter matching as today.
